name: Lusty Mother
source: Lusty Mother is a visual novel for adult audiences. You take on the role of a young boy who learns how to have sex under the guidance of his mother. They practice in secret from the unsuspecting father, as the mother wants her son to become a skilled lover.​
translation: 《欲望妈妈》是一部面向成人观众的视觉小说。你扮演一个小男孩的角色，他在母亲的指导下学习如何做爱。他们在毫无戒心的父亲面前秘密练习，因为母亲希望她的儿子成为一名熟练的情人。
